detail: server sanitizes each plan, restricts paid effort, rejects unconfirmed bodies and incompatible R6/layers or contradictory required pieces; existing products and 30-day duration retained

the confirmed bundle is resolved before garments, retains its body parts, consumes its real 60-Robux cost and fails explicitly when missing or over budget; absent optional hair is never marked complete
a required classic tee is a GraphicTShirt rather than a Shirt; a wrong exact type or missing specific per-piece subject fails instead of filling with an unrelated garment
visual body selection and advanced exact clothing IDs survive confirmation of all four stages; no catalog generation starts before the explicit confirmation
the actual remote server creates 5 + 5 + 2, charges one request, never reverts the last batch to five and gives each result a session-bound key
a batch belongs to a live Pro entitlement and current conversation; cancellation invalidates it; an upgrade uses the existing product and cannot grant access from the prompt callback
body/tone/hair/scale form keeps drafts separate, only the fourth-step confirmation calls skin state, Undo restores the previous look and hair uses the native accessory schema
outfit creation and saving the Roblox account avatar are distinct native prompts; denied/cancelled requests never say saved, while only Success confirms completion
server records only a completed and ownership-confirmed native catalog purchase, isolates users and batches persistence instead of writing on each UI open
a real bundle is validated as Animations, idle/walk use separate cache keys and tracks change on the same photo clone instead of rebuilding the avatar
the selected approved Roblox background is restored next time; head/body effects and clones live only in the disposable photo scene and never change the map avatar
catalog data comes from native search, five-column cards test the copied avatar; the independent selected-item purchase opens the official prompt
preview no longer sacrifices a 48–96-pixel rail; the full-width avatar, five actions and equipped strip remain inside the safe layout on seven sizes
stage success reflects an explicit done event, stop dispatches cancellation and Plus/Pro is reachable at the sidebar footer without covering the account button
two batches cannot repeat the same outfit even if the recent-account history is absent; the request uses bounded duplicate filters rather than an unlimited array of all results
